description:
Screenbox is a modern media player for all your devices, with support for a wide range of file formats.


What's Changed
This release delivers new swipe gesture options, improves context menus, playlist interactions, and playback options flyouts, fixes critical issues blocking NAOT, and lowers the minimum OS requirement to Windows 10 version 1903 (build 18362). It also includes significant refactoring for code maintainability and updated translations.
New Features
- feat: add track and chapter navigation swipe gesture options by @United600 in #1086
- feat: add current media to playlists via player context menu by @AbrarJahin in #1092
- feat: add context-menu to artists and albums search results by @United600 in #1099
Bug Fixes
- fix: resolve issues preventing NAOT build from launching by @United600 in #1085
- fix: add to playlist button in selection bar control by @United600 in #1093
- fix: lower OS min requirement from 10.0.19041 to 10.0.18362 by @huynhsontung in #1094
- fix: play/pause player OSD badge glyph on Windows 10 by @United600 in #1098
- fix: use package display name fallback by @huynhsontung in #1106
- fix: guard known-folder access with ApiInformation by @huynhsontung with @Copilot in #1108
Localization
- l10n: New Crowdin updates by @github-actions[bot] in #1080
User Experience
- style: add custom playback speed control by @United600 in #1105
Other Improvements
- refactor: CompositeTrackPicker control and some playback settings by @United600 in #1063
- refactor: item flyouts into reusable MediaMenuFlyout by @United600 in #1079
- refactor: artist, album, and playlist item flyouts with MediaMenuFlyout by @United600 in #1081
- refactor: notification view model handling by @United600 in #1087
- chore: NAOT build cleanup and minor CI update by @United600 in #1091
- refactor: rename SelectionBarControl.CommandParameter to Selection by @huynhsontung with @Copilot in #1096
New Contributors
- @AbrarJahin made their first contribution in #1092
Full Changelog: v0.22.0...v0.23.0
